dct_description_sm: A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2026-09-21 and updated as new data arrive. Made from VIIRS/JPSS2 Sea Ice Extent 6-Min L2 Swath 375m NRT (VJ229_NRT, version 2, doi:10.5067/VIIRS/VJ229_NRT.002).

The Visible Infrared Imager Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Sea Ice Extent 6-Min L2 Swath 375m is Near Real Time(NRT) (short name VJ229_NRT) product reports the location of sea ice cover derived from radiance data acquired by VIIRS. Following the approach used by MODIS, the algorithm assumes that sea ice is snow covered and can be detected using the Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI). The VIIRS instrument flies on board the NOAA-21 - formerly the Joint Polar Satellite System-2 (JPSS-2) satellite. For more information, consult product [users guide](https://viirsland.gsfc.nasa.gov/PDF/VIIRS%20C2%20Sea%20Ice%20Cover%20Product%20User%20Guide%20v3.pdf), and product [Algorithm Theoretical Basis Document (ATBD)](https://viirsland.gsfc.nasa.gov/PDF/VIIRS_SeaIceCover_ATBD_V2.pdf)
